changelog: - **A push-all Source whose connection leads to something other than a Pool now says why it moves nothing.** A Source set to push all sends on every one of its connections or on none. When one of them led to a Drain, a Gate, a Converter or an End, the Source quietly moved nothing on any connection, step after step, without a note — while a push-any Source in the same place pushed to its Pools and reported the odd connection. The line under the run row now names each such connection and its target every step; the Source still moves nothing until the connection is changed.
